name: Mineyama Shion
source:
Shion is a quiet girl and an unparalleled bibliophile; she is never seen without a book in one hand. She spends entire days shut in the library, indulging herself in reading. Shion reads a wide variety of books, so she is knowledgeable about many subjects and good at trivia. Although Shion will read books about almost anything, she has a secret preference for horror stories.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
